name: Serene Sleuth
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, investigate. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
At the beginning of combat on your turn, investigate for each goaded creature you control. Then each creature you control is no longer goaded.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of combat on your turn, investigate for each goaded creature you control. Then each creature you control is no longer goaded.

needs.what: an op that ends every goad on the matched permanents ("each creature you control is no longer goaded"): clears both goaded_by and goaded_permanently_by on each object in `objects`, regardless of which player goaded it or for how long
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only goad op is `goad` (duration, objects, player), which adds a goader and never removes one; lose_keyword, lose_all_abilities and remove_from_combat touch keywords, abilities and combat, not the goad sets. The first half of the sentence is expressible (begin_combat trigger with an is_your_turn condition, create_token clue_token with amount {count: {controller: you, types: [Creature], goaded: true}}), but writing it without the ungoad clause would leave the creatures goaded, so the line is blocked as a whole
